summary: Ryde Group Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that all board-submitted resolutions passed at its extraordinary general meeting held September 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Singapore time. Approved items include the fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles, an authorized share capital increase, a 1-for-150 reverse share split of Class A and Class B ordinary shares effective December 4, 2026, related fractional-entitlement treatment, the conditional fifth amended and restated articles, and director implementation authority. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a deal was disclosed; this is a routine shareholder-meeting outcome covering charter, capital-structure, and reverse-split mechanics.
